select driver_id, full_name as driver_name, hired_on
from "fleet"."main"."raw_driver_roster"
), t as (
    select * from "fleet"."main_staging"."stg_trips"
)

    t.trip_id,
    t.driver_id,
    d.driver_name,
    t.distance_km,
    v.capacity as vehicle_capacity,

),

parent as (

    from "fleet"."main"."raw_driver_roster"
)

    from_field

from child
left join parent
